description: Start a software-command batch. open:true keeps it mutable and idle until appended commands arrive. Commands execute through the existing unified interface; native when conditions own timing. Optional schedule retains legacy explicit native plans. A step may instead have commands:[{command,args},...] (2..64 renderer-only members) and one when condition: the group registers and updates atomically, launches all distinct control targets on one audio frame, preserves independent ramp durations, and completes after every member. when.after a group waits for its final member completion.

invalidate_action_ids.description: Atomically invalidate pending actions and append replacements in the same CAS transaction.

replacements.description: Optional invalidated action ID to appended replacement ID map. Pending dependents atomically follow the replacement; started dependents and cycles reject the entire patch.

description: Register software commands immediately. Each step is a canonical Request plus action_id and optional when; when.after names a readiness/executed dependency. Timing supports now, at_event, at_seconds, after_beats and after_seconds. invalidate_action_ids atomically replaces pending commands; no musical policy or handover document. A step may instead have commands:[{command,args},...] (2..64 renderer-only members) and one when condition: the group registers and updates atomically, launches all distinct control targets on one audio frame, preserves independent ramp durations, and completes after every member. when.after a group waits for its final member completion. replacements optionally retargets pending dependents from invalidated IDs to appended replacement IDs atomically; started dependents and cycles reject the patch. All steps register in one revision only after the entire append validates; a rejected append registers none of its steps. Dependencies may name another step in the same append, including a later step. Reusing an accepted action ID never replaces its original work.
Invalidate pending actions atomically without replaying or erasing applied actions. Invalidate complete same-event/dependency groups.
Optionally close a software-command job after queued work drains. Session stop uses jobs.cancel to cancel only its owned pending commands. Explicit legacy scheduled plans may supply completion_event.
